programs.title: Peter Rabbit
programs.desc: Peter Rabbit, the mischievous and adventurous hero who has captivated generations of readers, now takes on the starring role of his own cute, contemporary comedy with attitude. In the film, Peter's feud with Mr. McGregor escalates to greater heights than ever before as they rival for the affections of the warm-hearted animal lover who lives next door.

programs.title: Under The Tuscan Sun
programs.desc: Devastated by her philandering husband, a successful woman moves to Italy, buys a villa and befriends a married man.

programs.title: Searching
programs.desc: Missing person thriller which takes place entirely on screens. John Cho stars as a widower who must track down his missing 16-year-old daughter using only her social media accounts.

programs.title: The Mentor
programs.desc: A Cronulla florist is operated by Kim, who is struggling to juggle motherhood and operate a business. Kim can identify problems with her business, but needs Mark's expertise to turn her fortunes around.
